It is the latest count in a text document. The 3T26 BMV report gives none, and the 3T26 press release is a scanned image. Inbursa paid MXN 3,154,514,023 for repurchases in the first nine months of 2026 (3T26 BMV report, cash-flow statement), so the current count is somewhat lower. The ownership section is undated. asOf is the April 28, 2026 date of the report's audit opinion. Inbursa is not majority-owned by Grupo Carso or América Móvil: the controlling holders are Slim family members, and Criteria Caixa holds 5% to 10%.

notes: América Móvil, the primary company, stays in research/lenses/marketcap. Neither company's own documents call Carlos Slim Helú their founder. Their annual reports give the incorporation dates (Grupo Galas, now Grupo Carso, on October 22, 1980; Promotora Carso, now Grupo Financiero Inbursa, on May 20, 1985) and name Slim and his family as the controlling shareholders. Inbursa's report also says its controlling shareholders built the group by constituting and acquiring the financial firms in it. The founding attribution is from Slim's official biography at carlosslim.com (https://carlosslim.com/biografia.html), which is not a company site: "Funda Inversora Bursátil" (1965), "Se crea Grupo Galas, hoy Grupo Carso" (1980), and he "crea Grupo Financiero Inbursa". Other listed Slim-related companies were not added. Minera Frisco and Inmuebles Carso were spun off from Grupo Carso in 2010, and Frisco was originally acquired, not founded. Grupo Sanborns is 99.97% owned by Grupo Carso.
